limits: The fixture observes public Linux runner processes, not the phone.
It calls actual Identity::read and Identity::current but does not call bootstrap, stop, serve or the encrypted vault.
The ordinary native suite, Android cross-build and artifact upload were skipped in this diagnostic-only run.
The fixture does not establish that a duplicate server can start, that any record was lost, or that an actual service incident occurred.
A passing reproduction is not an acceptance test or a fix. Process-observation errors and shutdown uncertainty need a separate design and tests.
